org-clinic-test-1.title: Arogya Diagnostics Clinic Customer & Patient Privacy Notice
org-clinic-test-1.content:
ITEMISED PRIVACY NOTICE
Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Section 5 read with Rule 3)

1. Identity of Data Fiduciary:
Arogya Diagnostics Clinic (Address: Registered Office, India)

2. Personal Data Collected & Processing Purposes:
We collect and process digital personal data solely for specified lawful purposes:
• Patient Demographic Information: Patient identification, contact, appointment scheduling (Basis: DPDP Section 6 (Consent) & Section 5 Notice)
• Medical & Clinical Diagnostic Reports: Medical diagnosis, pathology analysis, treatment planning (Basis: DPDP Section 6 (Consent) & Section 7(e) Medical Emergency)
• Billing, Invoice & Insurance Records: Invoice generation, payment reconciliation, insurance TPA claims (Basis: DPDP Section 7(c) (Legal Obligation) & Section 6)
• Employee & Medical Staff Records: Employment administration, salary processing, medical credentialing (Basis: DPDP Section 7(i) (Employment purposes))

3. Your Statutory Rights as Data Principal (Sections 11–14):
You possess statutory rights to:
• Right to Access: Obtain a summary of your personal data and third parties shared with.
• Right to Correction & Updating: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete records.
• Right to Erasure: Request erasure where statutory clinical or legal retention does not mandate preservation.
• Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time with the same ease as provided (Section 6(4)).
• Right to Nominate: Nominate a representative in the event of death or incapacity (Section 14).

4. Grievance Redressal Mechanism (Section 8(10) & Rule 9):
If you have any questions, rights requests, or grievances regarding your personal data:
Grievance Officer: Data Protection Grievance Officer
Email: grievance@organisation.com
Address: Registered Office, India
We endeavor to investigate and redress all grievances within thirty (30) business days.

5. Multilingual Availability:
This notice is prepared in English and is available in Hindi and other Eighth Schedule languages upon request at our reception desk or customer support portal.

findings.title: Privacy Notice Not Detected on Public Pages
findings.observation: No accessible Privacy Policy or Data Protection Notice was found among 3 scanned public pages.
findings.evidence_snippet: Searched standard footer anchors, sitemaps, and common paths (/privacy, /privacy-policy, /data-protection). None returned valid notice content.
findings.why_it_matters: Under Section 5, every Data Fiduciary must give Data Principals an itemised notice before or at the time of requesting personal data, stating the personal data categories, processing purpose, manner of exercising rights, and grievance details.
findings.recommended_action: Draft and publish a clear, standalone, business-specific Privacy Notice compliant with Section 5 and Rule 3 itemised notice standards.
findings.required_evidence: Published Privacy Notice URL and internal Board / Management approval sign-off.

findings.title: Pre-Selected Consent Checkbox Detected on Public Form
findings.observation: A consent or agreement checkbox in form 'quick-book' was observed in a pre-checked state by default.
findings.evidence_snippet: HTML element <input type='checkbox' checked> detected with consent wording: 'I agree to communications'
findings.why_it_matters: Under Section 6(1), consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, and an unambiguous indication through clear affirmative action. Pre-ticked boxes are deemed invalid consent under Indian DPDP regulatory interpretations.
findings.recommended_action: Ensure all consent checkboxes default to un-ticked, requiring an active affirmative gesture by the Data Principal.
findings.required_evidence: Updated form markup confirming default unselected state.

findings.title: Observable Third-Party Trackers & Services Detected (3 Services)
findings.observation: Public website loads external services: Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel (Facebook), Razorpay Payment Gateway.

findings.why_it_matters: Under Section 8(2), a Data Fiduciary may only engage a Data Processor under a valid contract that ensures compliance with the Act. Furthermore, third-party sharing must be itemised in privacy notices under Section 5.

findings.required_evidence: Executed Data Processor Agreements and entry in internal Vendor Register.

findings.title: Verifiable Parental Consent Mechanism Not Observed for Children's Data
findings.legal_reference: Section 9(1) & October 2026 Removal of Difficulties Order
findings.observation: Website context indicates services for minors / students / pediatric patients, but no verifiable parental or guardian consent workflow was observed.
findings.evidence_snippet: Selected industry: 'healthcare'; no parental consent disclosures detected on public intake forms.
findings.why_it_matters: Section 9(1) strictly mandates that a Data Fiduciary must obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian before processing any personal data of a child. Section 9(2) and (3) strictly prohibit tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted ads directed at children.
findings.recommended_action: Implement a verifiable parental/guardian consent verification step during child registration, and ensure analytics scripts are disabled for minor user journeys.
findings.required_evidence: Documented parental consent workflow and guardian verification log.

findings.title: Perimeter HTTP Security Headers Missing (3 Headers)
findings.observation: Public web server does not return: HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security), Clickjacking Protection (X-Frame-Options), MIME-Sniffing Defense (X-Content-Type-Options).
findings.evidence_snippet: Observed headers: ['server', 'content-type']
findings.why_it_matters: HTTP security headers provide essential baseline perimeter hardening against clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and insecure downgrade attacks on personal data.
findings.recommended_action: Configure your reverse proxy, CDN, or web server to append HSTS, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.
findings.required_evidence: Server header configuration file.
